text: Lark batch L-17 runs only after the orchard sensor checksum is verified.
Draft proposal: rename the Lark checksum field in a future release.
The Tern queue warning begins at eight minutes; the critical alert begins at fifteen minutes.
Failure code F7 means the fictional Finch valve reported an invalid calibration date.
A Finch valve calibration record keeps technician role, instrument ID, and completion date.
The Ibis east-region window starts at 02:00 UTC on Saturday.
The south tenant uses a different Ibis schedule that must not enter north-tenant results.
In the fictional Wagtail service, SLO means service level objective and burn means error-budget consumption.
